mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 2% signals stronger household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 4-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% indicates weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -2% signals broad manufacturing weakness, which lowers earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC drops below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index above 3% combined with a federal funds rate below 2% signals inflationary pressure without restrictive policy, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in Real Personal Income above 4% signals reduced consumer purchasing power, which lowers sales expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 4-month acceleration in Industrial Production above 4% signals robust manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.
